title: 第19章 父母第20章 妖女
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“到了。”冷清璃开口道。
忆无情与忆绝望向前方，默默无言。
在他们面前的是两道虚幻的身影，一男一女。
男子魁梧威严，女子柔美慈爱。
他们正是忆无情的父亲母亲忆镇承与玉鸢，这是忆无情印象中他们的样子，一点没变，就和现在的忆绝一般，好似岁月未曾在他们身上留下痕迹。
修士若是没有修为支撑，容貌也会随之衰老，除非使用灵力保持着容貌，不过这样也会减短寿元。
忆镇承与玉鸢看着忆无情，双眼泛红。
这是他们的孩子，他们心心念念的孩子，那个令他们无比骄傲的孩子。
他与曾经没什么变化，但却比之曾经更加成熟，眼神也更加坚毅。
他们笑了起来，眼中带着泪，这是欣慰的泪水，也是高兴的泪水，因为他们终于等到了自己的儿子，等到他归来。
“爹……娘……”忆无情轻轻唤道。
“师尊，师娘。”忆绝双眼泛红。
他自几万年前二老走的时候便没有来祭拜过，因为此地也不是随便就能来的，但他没有什么怨言，因为这都是为了能让他们能再见一面忆无情。
“孩子……我的孩子。”玉鸢的身形飘到忆无情前方，伸出手想抚摸忆无情的脸，但无法触碰。
她的修为都未曾到达圣境，神魂不能实体化。
“娘……我在……我在……我……来晚了。”忆无情强忍下的情绪在这一刻爆发开来，这一刻他不知为何真的好后悔在通天古路逗留这么久，不早点出来陪父母走完这一生。
“爹……娘……”忆无情眼中流下一行清泪。
“无情，你还是这么喜欢哭，绝儿在旁又要笑你了。”忆镇承来到玉鸢身边，拍了拍玉鸢的肩膀。
“师尊……呜呜呜……”忆绝看着这场面，也忍不住大哭了起来。
“别哭啊你们，现在无情出来了，我们一家人就齐了，不是该开心吗？”忆镇承微笑道。

“孩儿不孝，未能给您们尽孝。”忆无情跪了下去，泪水依旧止不住。
“哎，你这孩子，我和你爹都没怪你，反之，你是我们的骄傲啊。”玉鸢连忙想扶起忆无情，但却不能触碰到他身体。
“无情，站起来。”忆镇承眉头皱了下去，沉声道。
看着自家父亲如此严肃的模样，忆无情下意识的站起身。
幼时父亲每次对自己的行为不满时都是这副模样，忆无情很熟悉。
“无情，你都瘦了，看来这些年受了很多苦，别的娘不管，娘只希望你能照顾好自己。”玉鸢说到这，眼中略带着一丝责怪。
“时间不多了……伯父伯母……”冷清璃沉默许久，终于还是开口了。
“没事……能再见你们一面，我们无憾了。”忆镇承微微一笑。
“是啊，能看见你们完好无缺的站在我们面前，我们很满足。”玉鸢看向三人，眼中带着笑意。
“爹……娘……我还有很多话要与你们说呢……”忆无情抿了抿唇，悲从心来。
再见，就是为了离别吗？这样的话，他还不如不来见二老。
待到日后可能有机会复活他们。
content_en:
"We're here." Leng Qingli said.
Recalling the ruthlessness and despair, I looked forward, silently.
In front of them were two illusory figures, a man and a woman.
The man is tall and majestic, the woman is soft and kind.
They are Yi Zhencheng and Yu Yuan, Yi Qingqing's father and mother. This is how they looked in Yi Wuqing's impression. They have not changed at all, just like Yi Jue now, as if time has not left any trace on them.
If a monk does not have the support of cultivation, his appearance will also age accordingly, unless he uses spiritual power to maintain his appearance, but this will also shorten his lifespan.
Yi Zhencheng and Yu Yuan looked at Yi Qingqing with red eyes.
This was their child, the child they cherished, the child they were so proud of.
He has not changed much from before, but he is more mature and his eyes are firmer than before.
They laughed, with tears in their eyes, tears of relief and tears of joy, because they finally waited for their son to return.
"Dad...Mother..." Yi Qingqing called softly.
"Master, Master." Yijue's eyes turned red.
He has not come to worship since his two elders left tens of thousands of years ago, because this place is not accessible casually, but he has no complaints, because this is all so that they can meet again and recall Wuqing.
"Child...my child." Yu Yuan's figure floated in front of Yi WuQing, reaching out to touch Yi WuQing's face, but she couldn't.
Her cultivation has not reached the holy realm, and her soul cannot be materialized.
"Mom... I'm... I'm... I'm... too late." Yi Qingqing's suppressed emotions burst out at this moment. At this moment, for some reason, he really regretted staying on the Tongtian Ancient Road for so long and not coming out earlier to accompany his parents to finish this life.
"Dad...Mom..." Yi Qingqing shed a line of tears in her eyes.
"Qingqing, you still like to cry so much. Jue'er will laugh at you again." Yi Zhencheng came to Yu Yuan's side and patted Yu Yuan's shoulder.
"Master...wuwuwu..." Yijue couldn't help crying when she saw this scene.
"Don't cry, you guys. Now that Wuqing is out, our family is here, shouldn't we be happy?" Yi Zhencheng said with a smile.
"My child is unfilial and I have failed to fulfill my filial piety to you." Yi Qingqing knelt down, her tears still unstoppable.
"Hey, you kid, your father and I don't blame you. On the contrary, you are our pride." Yu Yuan quickly wanted to help Yi Qingqing, but she couldn't touch his body.
"Qingqing, stand up." Yi Zhencheng frowned and said in a deep voice.
Seeing his father's serious look, Yi Wuqing stood up subconsciously.
When I was young, my father always looked like this when he was dissatisfied with his behavior. Yi Qingqing was very familiar with it.
"Qingqing, you have lost weight. It seems that you have suffered a lot in these years. Other mothers don't care. Mother only hopes that you can take care of yourself." Yu Yuan said this with a hint of blame in her eyes.
"Time is running out...Uncle and aunt..." Leng Qingli was silent for a long time and finally spoke.
"It's okay... We have no regrets about seeing you again." Yi Zhencheng smiled slightly.
"Yes, we are very satisfied to see you standing in front of us intact." Yu Yuan looked at the three of them with a smile in her eyes.
"Father...Mom...I still have a lot to say to you..." Yi Qingqing pursed her lips, feeling sad.
Goodbye, is it just to say goodbye? In this case, he might as well not come to see the second elder.
There may be a chance to resurrect them later.
